label: Weight of evidence for a KER
description: Returns the weight-of-evidence text of one Key Event Relationship: biological plausibility (nci:C80263), empirical support (edam:data_2042), uncertainties and inconsistencies (nci:C71478) and quantitative understanding (edam:operation_3799), with its upstream and downstream Key Events. The predicates come from NCIt and EDAM, so their names say little; their rdfs:label in this endpoint names the AOP-Wiki field. Only about 700 KERs have this text, so each field is OPTIONAL.
